> **Data availability**

> This script runs entirely from the four phyloseq objects in `../phyloseq_objects/`
> (already filtered/QC'd exactly as described in the Methods — this script does not
> re-derive that filtering). Supplementary Tables 1–2 (reads per sample; merged ASV
> counts + taxonomy) and the per-dataset phylogenetic trees are published as static
> files in `../supplementary_tables/` rather than regenerated here.

# Shared Color Map {.tabset}

The same Family → Genus color lookup is used across all figures so that identical taxa always appear in identical colors.

```{r shared-colormap}
family_base_colors <- c(
  "Acetobacteraceae"       = "#08519C",
  "Acholeplasmataceae"     = "lightyellow",
  "Alcaligenaceae"         = "#FF00FF",
  "Alcanivoracaceae1"      = "#E43FAD",
  "Alteromonadaceae"       = "#EA6CC0",
  "Azospirillaceae"        = "#666600",
  "Bacillaceae"            = "#4B0082",
  "Brevibacillaceae"       = "#B2DF8A",
  "Brevibacteriaceae"      = "#114578",
  "Caulobacteraceae"       = "#185EA5",
  "Cellvibrionaceae"       = "#1E78D2",
  "Chitinophagaceae"       = "#FFFF00",
  "Clostridiaceae"         = "#6CABEA",
  "Comamonadaceae"         = "#FFD700",
  "Corynebacteriaceae"     = "#117878",
  "Crocinitomicaceae"      = "#18A5A5",
  "Cyclobacteriaceae"      = "#3FE4E4",
  "Cytophagaceae"          = "#D1A33D",
  "Dermabacteraceae"       = "#666600",
  "Devosiaceae"            = "orange",
  "Dietziaceae"            = "lightcyan",
  "Enterobacteriaceae"     = "red",
  "Flavobacteriaceae"      = "#D1A33D",
  "Gemmatimonadaceae"      = "darkorange1",
  "JG30-KF-CM45"          = "#8A2BE2",
  "Kaistiaceae"            = "#c51b7d",
  "Lachnospiraceae"        = "#A6CEE3",
  "Lactobacillaceae"       = "#41AB5D",
  "Lysobacteraceae"        = "#98F0C4",
  "Microbacteriaceae"      = "#1E90FF",
  "Micrococcaceae"         = "orange",
  "Moraxellaceae"          = "#D2D21E",
  "Myxococcaceae"          = "#E4E43F",
  "Nocardiaceae"           = "#A5A518",
  "Oxalobacteraceae"       = "#F0F098",
  "Paenibacillaceae"       = "#6A3D9A",
  "Pirellulaceae"          = "#784511",
  "Planococcaceae"         = "#A55E18",
  "Pseudomonadaceae"       = "lightblue",
  "Rhizobiaceae"           = "#7570B3",
  "Rhodocyclaceae"         = "#800080",
  "Rubinisphaeraceae"      = "#1E90FF",
  "Saprospiraceae"         = "darkseagreen",
  "Solirubrobacteraceae"   = "#17BECF",
  "Sphingobacteriaceae"    = "#33A02C",
  "Spirosomaceae"          = "#599861",
  "Sporolactobacillaceae"  = "purple",
  "Staphylococcaceae"      = "#D2781E",
  "Thermoactinomycetaceae" = "#771155",
  "Thermomonosporaceae"    = "#AA4488",
  "Verrucomicrobiaceae"    = "#228B22",
  "Xanthomonadaceae"       = "darkolivegreen1",
  "Arcobacteraceae"        = "lightpink"
)

taxa_files <- c(
  "../phyloseq_objects/Figure01_CEP_Age_pseq.rds",
  "../phyloseq_objects/Figure_02_CME_Aging_pseq.rds",
  "../phyloseq_objects/Figure_03_BCME_Aging_pseq.rds"
)
tax_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(taxa_files, function(f) {
  tt <- phyloseq::tax_table(readRDS(f))
  data.frame(Family = as.character(tt[, "Family"]),
             Genus  = as.character(tt[, "Genus"]),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
tax_all$Family[is.na(tax_all$Family)] <- "Unclassified Family"
tax_all <- unique(tax_all)

families     <- sort(unique(tax_all$Family))
missing_fams <- setdiff(families, names(family_base_colors))
if (length(missing_fams) > 0) {
  extra <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"))(length(missing_fams))
  family_base_colors <- c(family_base_colors, setNames(extra, missing_fams))
}

genus_color_list <- lapply(families, function(fam) {
  fam_rows         <- tax_all[tax_all$Family == fam, ]
  genera           <- sort(unique(fam_rows$Genus[!is.na(fam_rows$Genus)]))
  has_unclassified <- any(is.na(fam_rows$Genus))
  labels <- c(paste0(fam, ": ", genera),
              if (has_unclassified) paste(fam, "unclassified_genus"))
  n        <- length(labels)
  base_col <- family_base_colors[[fam]]
  if (n == 1) {
    shades <- base_col
  } else {
    amounts <- seq(-0.35, 0.45, length.out = n)
    shades  <- vapply(amounts, function(a) {
      if (a < 0) colorspace::darken(base_col, amount = -a)
      else       colorspace::lighten(base_col, amount =  a)
    }, character(1))
  }
  setNames(shades, labels)
})

my_colors_genus                       <- unlist(genus_color_list)
my_colors_genus["Genus < 2% abund."] <- "lightgrey"

# Save to disk so any chunk that follows an rm(list=ls()) can reload instantly
saveRDS(my_colors_genus,    "my_colors_genus.rds")
saveRDS(family_base_colors, "family_base_colors.rds")
```

# Figure 1 — CME Stability

> | Panel | Description |
> |-------|-------------|
> | **A** | Schematic — assembled in Adobe Illustrator |
> | **B** | Stacked bar: Genus-level composition (Stock CME + Seeded plates, by Day/Replicate) |
> | **C** | Alpha diversity over time: Observed, Shannon, Faith's PD — **CME Stock** only |
> | **D** | Alpha diversity over time: Observed, Shannon, Faith's PD — **Seeded plates** only |
> | **E** | PCA ordination (CLR / Euclidean distance) |
> | **F** | PCoA ordination (Weighted UniFrac) |

## Build Phyloseq Object

```{r fig1-build-phyloseq}
rm(list = ls())
# Loads the final, already-filtered/QC'd phyloseq object for Figure 1
# (mitochondria removed, low-abundance ASVs and low-depth samples pruned,
# weekly labels recoded to day numbers — see Methods for the exact criteria).
pseq <- readRDS("../phyloseq_objects/Figure01_CEP_Age_pseq.rds")
saveRDS(pseq, "Figure01_CEP_Age_pseq.rds")  # local copy so later chunks' bare readRDS() still works
pseq
```

## Panel B — Stacked Bar Plot (Genus Level)

```{r fig1B-prep}
# Note: no rm(list=ls()) here — my_colors_genus from the shared colormap must persist
pseq <- readRDS("Figure01_CEP_Age_pseq.rds")

y1 <- tax_glom(pseq, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = FALSE)
y3 <- transform_sample_counts(y1, function(x) x / sum(x))
y4 <- psmelt(y3)
y4$Family <- as.character(y4$Family)
y4$Genus  <- as.character(y4$Genus)
y4$Family[is.na(y4$Family)] <- "Unclassified Family"
y4$FamilyGenus <- ifelse(is.na(y4$Genus),
                         paste(y4$Family, "unclassified_genus"),
                         paste0(y4$Family, ": ", y4$Genus))
y4$FamilyGenus[y4$Abundance < 0.02] <- "Genus < 2% abund."
```

```{r fig1B-colormap-apply}
# Reload color map in case a prior rm(list=ls()) cleared the environment
if (!exists("my_colors_genus"))    my_colors_genus    <- readRDS("my_colors_genus.rds")
if (!exists("family_base_colors")) family_base_colors <- readRDS("family_base_colors.rds")
y4$FamilyGenus <- factor(y4$FamilyGenus, levels = names(my_colors_genus))
```

```{r fig1B-plot, fig.width=20, fig.height=5}
plot_height_in <- 5
max_rows       <- max(1, floor(plot_height_in / 0.22))
legend_ncol    <- ceiling(nlevels(droplevels(y4$FamilyGenus)) / max_rows)
plot_width_in  <- 20 + max(0, legend_ncol - 2) * 1.3

p_B <- ggplot(y4, aes(x = Replicate, y = Abundance, fill = FamilyGenus)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors_genus) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = legend_ncol, keywidth = 0.4, keyheight = 0.7)) +
  ylab("Distribution of ASVs at Genus level") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
        axis.text   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 13),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank()) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(Category, Day))

print(p_B)
ggsave("Fig1B_StackPlot_Genus.pdf", p_B, height = plot_height_in, width = plot_width_in)
```

## Panels C & D — Alpha Diversity Over Time

### Observed + Shannon

```{r fig1CD-richness, fig.width=8, fig.height=3}
rm(list = ls())
pseq <- readRDS("Figure01_CEP_Age_pseq.rds")

richness_data     <- plot_richness(pseq, x = "Replicate",
                                   measures = c("Observed", "Shannon"))$data
richness_data$Day <- factor(richness_data$Day, levels = c("D00", "D05", "D08"))

averages_data <- richness_data %>%
  group_by(Day, Category, variable) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(avg_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
                   sd_value  = sd(value,  na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

p_C <- ggplot(averages_data %>% filter(Category == "Fresh"),
              aes(x = Day, y = avg_value, group = variable)) +
  geom_line(color = "red") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = avg_value - sd_value, ymax = avg_value + sd_value),
                width = 0.2, color = "red") +
  geom_point(size = 2, color = "red") +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Day", y = "Mean Index Value", title = "Panel C — CME Stock") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)

p_D <- ggplot(averages_data %>% filter(Category != "Fresh"),
              aes(x = Day, y = avg_value, group = variable)) +
  geom_line(color = "darkgreen") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = avg_value - sd_value, ymax = avg_value + sd_value),
                width = 0.2, color = "darkgreen") +
  geom_point(size = 2, color = "darkgreen") +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Day", y = "Mean Index Value", title = "Panel D — Seeded Plates") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)

print(p_C); print(p_D)
ggsave("Fig1C_StockCME_Observed_Shannon.pdf",    p_C, height = 3, width = 6)
ggsave("Fig1D_SeededPlates_Observed_Shannon.pdf", p_D, height = 3, width = 6)
```

#### Statistics — Observed & Shannon

```{r fig1CD-alpha-stats}
sequential_stats <- richness_data %>%
  group_by(Category, variable) %>%
  t_test(value ~ Day, comparisons = list(c("D00", "D05"), c("D00", "D08"))) %>%
  select(Category, variable, group1, group2, n1, n2, p, p.adj) %>%
  arrange(Category, variable, group1)
print(as.data.frame(sequential_stats))
```

### Faith's Phylogenetic Diversity

```{r fig1CD-faith, fig.width=5, fig.height=3}
rm(list = ls())
pseq <- readRDS("Figure01_CEP_Age_pseq.rds")

rooted_tree            <- midpoint.root(phy_tree(pseq))
otu_mat                <- as(otu_table(pseq), "matrix")
pd_results             <- pd(otu_mat, rooted_tree, include.root = TRUE)
richness_data          <- data.frame(sample_data(pseq))
richness_data$Faith_PD <- pd_results$PD
richness_data$Day      <- factor(richness_data$Day, levels = c("D00", "D05", "D08"))

averages_pd <- richness_data %>%
  group_by(Day, Category) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(avg_pd = mean(Faith_PD, na.rm = TRUE),
                   sd_pd  = sd(Faith_PD,  na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

p_C_faith <- ggplot(averages_pd %>% filter(Category == "Fresh"),
                    aes(x = Day, y = avg_pd, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(color = "red") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = avg_pd - sd_pd, ymax = avg_pd + sd_pd),
                width = 0.2, color = "red") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Day", y = "Mean Faith Index", title = "Panel C — CME Stock") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)

p_D_faith <- ggplot(averages_pd %>% filter(Category != "Fresh"),
                    aes(x = Day, y = avg_pd, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(color = "darkgreen") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = avg_pd - sd_pd, ymax = avg_pd + sd_pd),
                width = 0.2, color = "darkgreen") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "darkgreen") +
  labs(x = "Day", y = "Mean Faith Index", title = "Panel D — Seeded Plates") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)

print(p_C_faith); print(p_D_faith)
ggsave("Fig1C_StockCME_FaithPD.pdf",    p_C_faith, height = 3, width = 3)
ggsave("Fig1D_SeededPlates_FaithPD.pdf", p_D_faith, height = 3, width = 3)
```

#### Statistics — Faith's PD

```{r fig1CD-faith-stats}
faith_stats <- richness_data %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  t_test(Faith_PD ~ Day, comparisons = list(c("D00", "D05"), c("D00", "D08"))) %>%
  select(Category, group1, group2, n1, n2, p, p.adj) %>%
  arrange(Category, group1)
print(as.data.frame(faith_stats))
```

## Panel E — PCA (CLR / Euclidean)

```{r fig1E-pca, fig.width=5, fig.height=3.5}
rm(list = ls())
pseq     <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(readRDS("Figure01_CEP_Age_pseq.rds")) > 1,
                       readRDS("Figure01_CEP_Age_pseq.rds"))
day_cols <- c("D00" = "#73C474", "D05" = "#F89452", "D08" = "#DE402E")

pseq.clr    <- microbiome::transform(pseq, "clr")
ord_pca_clr <- ordinate(pseq.clr, "RDA", "euclidean")
evals       <- ord_pca_clr$CA$eig
pc1_var     <- round(100 * evals[1] / sum(evals), 1)
pc2_var     <- round(100 * evals[2] / sum(evals), 1)

p_E <- plot_ordination(pseq.clr, ord_pca_clr, shape = "Category", color = "Day") +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  xlab(paste0("[", pc1_var, "%]")) + ylab(paste0("[", pc2_var, "%]")) +
  ggtitle("Euclidean distance") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = day_cols)

print(p_E)
ggsave("Fig1E_PCA_CLR.pdf", p_E, height = 3.5, width = 5)
```

#### PERMANOVA — Overall, Stock CME, Seeded Plates

```{r fig1E-permanova}
dist_clr <- phyloseq::distance(pseq.clr, method = "euclidean")
metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(pseq.clr))
cat("--- Overall ---\n");          print(adonis2(dist_clr ~ Category * Day, by = "term", data = metadata))

ps_s <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(subset_samples(pseq, Category == "Fresh")) > 1,
                   subset_samples(pseq, Category == "Fresh"))
cat("--- Within Stock CME ---\n"); print(adonis2(phyloseq::distance(microbiome::transform(ps_s,"clr"), "euclidean") ~ Day,
                                                 data = data.frame(sample_data(ps_s)), by = "term"))

ps_p <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(subset_samples(pseq, Category != "Fresh")) > 1,
                   subset_samples(pseq, Category != "Fresh"))
cat("--- Within Seeded Plates ---\n"); print(adonis2(phyloseq::distance(microbiome::transform(ps_p,"clr"), "euclidean") ~ Day,
                                                     data = data.frame(sample_data(ps_p)), by = "term"))
```

## Panel F — PCoA (Weighted UniFrac)

```{r fig1F-pcoa, fig.width=5, fig.height=3.5}
rm(list = ls())
set.seed(123)
pseq0 <- readRDS("Figure01_CEP_Age_pseq.rds")
pseq  <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(pseq0) > 1, pseq0)
phy_tree(pseq) <- midpoint.root(phy_tree(pseq))
pseq_rel       <- transform_sample_counts(pseq, function(x) x / sum(x))
dist_wu        <- distance(pseq_rel, method = "unifrac", weighted = TRUE)
ord_wu         <- ordinate(pseq_rel, method = "PCoA", distance = dist_wu)
evals          <- ord_wu$values$Eigenvalues
day_cols       <- c("D00" = "#73C474", "D05" = "#F89452", "D08" = "#DE402E")

p_F <- plot_ordination(pseq_rel, ord_wu, shape = "Category", color = "Day") +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  xlab(paste0("[", round(100 * evals[1] / sum(evals), 1), "%]")) +
  ylab(paste0("[", round(100 * evals[2] / sum(evals), 1), "%]")) +
  ggtitle("Weighted UniFrac distance") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = day_cols)

print(p_F)
ggsave("Fig1F_PCoA_wUniFrac.pdf", p_F, height = 3.5, width = 5)
```

#### PERMANOVA — Overall, Stock CME, Seeded Plates

```{r fig1F-permanova}
cat("--- Overall ---\n"); print(adonis2(dist_wu ~ Category * Day, by = "term",
                                        data = data.frame(sample_data(pseq_rel))))

root_sub <- function(ps) { phy_tree(ps) <- midpoint.root(phy_tree(ps)); ps }
rel_sub  <- function(ps) transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) x / sum(x))

ps_s <- rel_sub(root_sub(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(subset_samples(pseq, Category == "Fresh")) > 1,
                                    subset_samples(pseq, Category == "Fresh"))))
set.seed(123); cat("--- Within Stock CME ---\n")
print(adonis2(distance(ps_s, "unifrac", weighted=TRUE) ~ Day,
              data = data.frame(sample_data(ps_s)), permutations = 999, by = "margin"))

ps_p <- rel_sub(root_sub(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(subset_samples(pseq, Category != "Fresh")) > 1,
                                    subset_samples(pseq, Category != "Fresh"))))
set.seed(123); cat("--- Within Seeded Plates ---\n")
print(adonis2(distance(ps_p, "unifrac", weighted=TRUE) ~ Day,
              data = data.frame(sample_data(ps_p)), permutations = 999, by = "margin"))
```

# Figure 2 — CME Aging (CME-1 & CME-2)

> | Panel | Description |
> |-------|-------------|
> | **A** | Stacked bar: Genus-level composition — CME-1 (stock / grazed lawn / worms) & CME-2 |
> | **B** | PCoA (Weighted UniFrac) — CME-1: Stock CME vs Grazed Lawn vs Worms |
> | **C** | PCoA (Weighted UniFrac) — CME-2: Stock CME vs Grazed Lawn vs Worms |
> | **D** | Shannon diversity over time — Worms on CME-1 & Worms on CME-2 |

## Build Phyloseq Objects

### CME-1

```{r fig2-build-cme1}
rm(list = ls())
# Final, already-filtered/QC'd CME-1 phyloseq object (mitochondria removed,
# low-abundance ASVs and low-depth samples pruned — see Methods).
pseq <- readRDS("../phyloseq_objects/Figure_02_CME_Aging_pseq.rds")
saveRDS(pseq, "Figure_02_CME_Aging_pseq.rds")  # local copy so later chunks' bare readRDS() still works
pseq
```

### CME-2

```{r fig2-build-cme2}
# Final, already-filtered/QC'd CME-2 (BCEP) phyloseq object: only the
# worm, grazed-lawn, and Day-07 Stock_CME samples analyzed in the paper are
# present — see Methods for sample selection and QC criteria.
pseq <- readRDS("../phyloseq_objects/Figure_03_BCME_Aging_pseq.rds")
saveRDS(pseq, "Figure_03_BCME_Aging_pseq.rds")  # local copy so later chunks' bare readRDS() still works
pseq
```

### Merge CME-1 + CME-2

```{r fig2-merge}
rm(list = ls())
# Tree-free, full 9231-taxon merged object (identical to what the original
# analysis's own merge step produces) — Panel D and the Enterobacteriaceae
# LMM use this directly. Panels B/C need a tree, which they attach
# themselves in fig2BC-load from a small separately-published tree file
# (see that chunk) — attaching a tree there also drops ASVs the tree
# doesn't cover, which must only affect Panels B/C, not Panel D or the LMM.
pseq <- readRDS("../phyloseq_objects/CEPBCEPAging.rds")
saveRDS(pseq, "CEPBCEPAging.rds")  # local copy so later chunks' bare readRDS() still works
pseq
```

## Panel A — Stacked Bar Plots (CME-1 & CME-2)

```{r fig2A-prep}
# Reload shared color objects cleared by earlier rm(list=ls())
if (!exists("my_colors_genus"))    my_colors_genus    <- readRDS("my_colors_genus.rds")
if (!exists("family_base_colors")) family_base_colors <- readRDS("family_base_colors.rds")

always_show_families <- "Enterobacteriaceae"
collapse_threshold   <- 0.02

prep_genus_data <- function(path) {
  ps <- readRDS(path)
  y4 <- psmelt(transform_sample_counts(tax_glom(ps, "Genus", NArm=FALSE), function(x) x/sum(x)))
  y4$Family <- as.character(y4$Family);  y4$Genus <- as.character(y4$Genus)
  y4$Family[is.na(y4$Family)] <- "Unclassified Family"
  y4$FamilyGenus <- ifelse(is.na(y4$Genus),
    paste(y4$Family, "unclassified_genus"), paste0(y4$Family, ": ", y4$Genus))
  y4$FamilyGenus[y4$Abundance < collapse_threshold &
                 !(y4$Family %in% always_show_families)] <- "Genus < 2% abund."
  y4
}

y4_cme1 <- prep_genus_data("Figure_02_CME_Aging_pseq.rds")
y4_cme2 <- prep_genus_data("Figure_03_BCME_Aging_pseq.rds")
```

```{r fig2A-union-legend}
combined_abund <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  y4_cme1[, c("Family","FamilyGenus","Abundance")],
  y4_cme2[, c("Family","FamilyGenus","Abundance")])
family_rank <- combined_abund %>% group_by(Family) %>%
  summarise(total=sum(Abundance),.groups="drop") %>% arrange(desc(total)) %>% pull(Family)
genus_rank  <- combined_abund %>% filter(FamilyGenus != "Genus < 2% abund.") %>%
  group_by(Family, FamilyGenus) %>% summarise(total=sum(Abundance),.groups="drop")
ordered_levels <- unlist(lapply(family_rank, function(f)
  genus_rank %>% filter(Family==f) %>% arrange(desc(total)) %>% pull(FamilyGenus)), use.names=FALSE)
present      <- union(unique(y4_cme1$FamilyGenus), unique(y4_cme2$FamilyGenus))
union_levels <- ordered_levels[ordered_levels %in% names(my_colors_genus)]
if ("Genus < 2% abund." %in% present) union_levels <- c(union_levels, "Genus < 2% abund.")
missing_c <- setdiff(union_levels, names(my_colors_genus))
if (length(missing_c) > 0) {
  my_colors_genus <- c(my_colors_genus,
    setNames(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8,"Set3"))(length(missing_c)), missing_c))
}
y4_cme1$FamilyGenus <- factor(y4_cme1$FamilyGenus, levels = union_levels)
y4_cme2$FamilyGenus <- factor(y4_cme2$FamilyGenus, levels = union_levels)

panel_h   <- 5; total_h <- 2 * panel_h + 0.3; panel_w <- 20
max_rows  <- max(1, floor(total_h / 0.22)); leg_ncol <- ceiling(length(union_levels)/max_rows)
leg_w     <- 2 + max(0, leg_ncol - 1) * 1.3; total_w <- panel_w + leg_w
```

```{r fig2A-plot, fig.width=22, fig.height=10.3}
build_p <- function(y4, ylab) {
  ggplot(y4, aes(x=Replicate, y=Abundance, fill=FamilyGenus)) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity", position="fill") + theme_classic() +
    scale_fill_manual(values=my_colors_genus, limits=union_levels, drop=FALSE) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop=TRUE) + ylab(ylab) +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,vjust=1,hjust=1),
          axis.text=element_text(face="bold",size=12),
          strip.text.x=element_text(size=12), legend.position="none",
          panel.grid.major=element_blank()) +
    facet_grid(cols=vars(Category,Day), scales="free_x", space="free_x")
}
leg_src <- ggplot(data.frame(FamilyGenus=factor(union_levels,levels=union_levels)),
                  aes(x=1,y=1,fill=FamilyGenus)) + geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values=my_colors_genus, limits=union_levels, drop=FALSE) +
  guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol=leg_ncol, keywidth=0.4, keyheight=0.7)) +
  theme(legend.text=element_text(size=13))
p_A <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  build_p(y4_cme1, "CME-1: Distribution of ASVs at Genus level") /
  build_p(y4_cme2, "CME-2: Distribution of ASVs at Genus level"),
  cowplot::get_legend(leg_src), ncol=2, rel_widths=c(panel_w, leg_w))
print(p_A)
ggsave("Fig2A_StackPlot_CME1_CME2.pdf", p_A, height=total_h, width=total_w, limitsize=FALSE)
```

## Panels B & C — PCoA (Weighted UniFrac)

```{r fig2BC-load}
rm(list = ls())
set.seed(125)
# The tree is published separately as just the already-fitted,
# midpoint-rooted `phylo` object (a few MB), not the full ~135MB fitGTR fit
# — merging it in here reproduces the original's merge_phyloseq(ps, tree)
# step exactly, including the same taxa drop (9231 -> 8275) that step
# always caused, which is specific to Panels B/C.
ps   <- readRDS("CEPBCEPAging.rds")
tree <- readRDS("../phyloseq_objects/CEPBCEPAging_tree.rds")
pseq <- merge_phyloseq(ps, tree)
day_colors <- c(Stock_CME="gray", D00="#1A9850", D01="#66BD63", D03="#A6D96A",
                D05="#FDAE61", D07="#F46D43", D08="darkred", D09="black")
```

```{r fig2B-plot, fig.width=5, fig.height=3.5}
ps_c1  <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(subset_samples(pseq, Experiment=="CEP_Age"))>1,
                     subset_samples(pseq, Experiment=="CEP_Age"))
set.seed(9567)
ps_c1c <- microbiome::transform(ps_c1, "compositional")
ord1   <- ordinate(ps_c1c, "PCoA", "unifrac", weighted=TRUE)
ev1    <- ord1$values$Eigenvalues
p_B <- plot_ordination(ps_c1c, ord1, shape="Category", color="Day") + geom_point(size=4) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1 [",round(100*ev1[1]/sum(ev1),1),"%]")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2 [",round(100*ev1[2]/sum(ev1),1),"%]")) +
  ggtitle("CME-1 vs. worms") + theme_classic(base_size=12) +
  theme(plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5,face="bold")) +
  scale_color_manual(values=day_colors) + scale_shape_manual(values=c(15,16,17))
print(p_B)
ggsave("Fig2B_PCoA_CME1.pdf", p_B, height=3.5, width=5)
```

#### PERMANOVA — CME-1

```{r fig2B-permanova}
phy_tree(ps_c1c) <- phytools::midpoint.root(phy_tree(ps_c1c))
set.seed(9567); print(adonis2(phyloseq::distance(ps_c1c,"wunifrac") ~ Category,
                              data=data.frame(sample_data(ps_c1c)), permutations=999))
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)

# Root phylogenetic tree
phy_tree(ps_c1c) <- phytools::midpoint.root(phy_tree(ps_c1c))

# Calculate weighted UniFrac distance
dist_wunifrac <- phyloseq::distance(ps_c1c, method = "wunifrac")

# Extract metadata
meta <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_c1c))
meta$Category <- as.character(meta$Category)

# Define pairwise comparisons
comparisons <- list(
  c("Grazed_Lawn", "Stock_CME"),
  c("worms", "Stock_CME"),
  c("Grazed_Lawn", "worms")
)

# Run pairwise PERMANOVA
set.seed(9567)

pairwise_results <- lapply(comparisons, function(groups) {

  # Identify samples belonging to the two groups
  selected_samples <- rownames(meta)[meta$Category %in% groups]

  # Subset metadata
  meta_sub <- meta[selected_samples, , drop = FALSE]

  # Subset distance matrix
  dist_sub <- as.dist(as.matrix(dist_wunifrac)[
    selected_samples,
    selected_samples
  ])

  # Run PERMANOVA
  adonis2(
    dist_sub ~ Category,
    data = meta_sub,
    permutations = 999
  )
})

# Name comparisons
names(pairwise_results) <- c(
  "Grazed_Lawn_vs_Stock_CME",
  "worms_vs_Stock_CME",
  "Grazed_Lawn_vs_worms"
)

# Print results
pairwise_results
```

## Panel D — Shannon Diversity (Worms)

```{r fig2D-shannon, fig.width=7, fig.height=3}
rm(list = ls())
ps <- readRDS("CEPBCEPAging.rds")

get_shannon <- function(ps, exp) {
  samdf <- data.frame(sample_data(ps))
  keep  <- samdf$Experiment == exp & samdf$Category == "worms"
  ps_s  <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(prune_samples(rownames(samdf)[keep], ps)) > 1,
                      prune_samples(rownames(samdf)[keep], ps))
  plot_richness(ps_s, x="Replicate", measures="Shannon")$data %>%
    group_by(Day) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(avg=mean(value,na.rm=TRUE), sd=sd(value,na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
}

sh1 <- get_shannon(ps, "CEP_Age")
sh2 <- get_shannon(ps, "BCEP")

make_sh <- function(df, ttl) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x=Day, y=avg, group=1)) +
    geom_line(linewidth=0.8) + geom_point(size=2.5) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=avg-sd, ymax=avg+sd), width=0.2) +
    labs(title=ttl, x="Days of adulthood", y="Shannon index") +
    theme_classic(base_size=12) + theme(plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5))
}

p1 <- make_sh(sh1, "Worms on CME-1")
p2 <- make_sh(sh2, "Worms on CME-2")
print(p1 + p2)
ggsave("Fig2D_Shannon_CME1.pdf", p1, height=3, width=3.5)
ggsave("Fig2D_Shannon_CME2.pdf", p2, height=3, width=3.5)
```

#### Statistics — Shannon

```{r fig2D-shannon-stats}
get_rd <- function(ps, exp, ref) {
  samdf <- data.frame(sample_data(ps))
  keep  <- samdf$Experiment == exp & samdf$Category == "worms"
  ps_s  <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(prune_samples(rownames(samdf)[keep], ps)) > 1,
                      prune_samples(rownames(samdf)[keep], ps))
  rd    <- plot_richness(ps_s, x="Replicate", measures="Shannon")$data
  rd$Day <- relevel(as.factor(rd$Day), ref=ref)
  rd
}
cat("--- CME-1 ---\n")
print(get_rd(ps,"CEP_Age","D01") %>% t_test(value~Day, ref.group="D01") %>% add_significance())
cat("--- CME-2 ---\n")
print(get_rd(ps,"BCEP","D01") %>% t_test(value~Day, ref.group="D01") %>% add_significance())
```

## Enterobacteriaceae Relative Abundance — LMM

```{r fig2-entero-lmm, fig.width=9, fig.height=4}
rm(list = ls())
ps <- readRDS("CEPBCEPAging.rds")

get_entero <- function(ps, exp) {
  samdf <- data.frame(sample_data(ps))
  keep  <- samdf$Experiment == exp & samdf$Category %in% c("Grazed_Lawn","worms")
  pseq  <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(prune_samples(rownames(samdf)[keep], ps)) > 0,
                      prune_samples(rownames(samdf)[keep], ps))
  y3    <- psmelt(transform_sample_counts(tax_glom(pseq,"Family"), function(x) x/sum(x)))
  y3$Family <- as.character(y3$Family)
  df    <- y3[y3$Family=="Enterobacteriaceae",]
  df$Day_numeric <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]","",df$Day))
  df$Replicate   <- factor(df$Replicate)
  lmm_w <- lmer(Abundance ~ Day_numeric + (1|Replicate), data=df[df$Category=="worms",])
  lmm_l <- lmer(Abundance ~ Day_numeric + (1|Replicate), data=df[df$Category=="Grazed_Lawn",])
  list(
    avg  = df %>% group_by(Category, Day_numeric) %>%
           dplyr::summarize(avg=mean(Abundance,na.rm=TRUE), sd=sd(Abundance,na.rm=TRUE),.groups="drop"),
    wp   = summary(lmm_w)$coefficients["Day_numeric","Pr(>|t|)"],
    lp   = summary(lmm_l)$coefficients["Day_numeric","Pr(>|t|)"]
  )
}

e1 <- get_entero(ps, "CEP_Age")
e2 <- get_entero(ps, "BCEP")

cat_cols <- c(worms="red", Grazed_Lawn="darkgreen")
cat_lbls <- c(worms="Worm gut", Grazed_Lawn="Grazed lawn")

make_ep <- function(d, label, wp, lp) {
  ann <- paste0(label,"\nworms: p = ",format(round(wp,3),nsmall=3),
                ",\ngrazed lawn: p = ",format(round(lp,3),nsmall=3))
  ggplot(d, aes(x=Day_numeric, y=avg, color=Category, group=Category)) +
    geom_line(linewidth=0.9) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=avg-sd, ymax=avg+sd), width=0.3) +
    geom_point(size=2.5) +
    annotate("text", x=-Inf, y=Inf, hjust=-0.08, vjust=1.4, label=ann, size=3.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values=cat_cols, labels=cat_lbls) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks=sort(unique(d$Day_numeric))) +
    labs(x="Day", y="Enterobacteriaceae relative abundance", color=NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size=12) + theme(legend.position="none")
}

leg_p <- ggplot(data.frame(Category=factor(c("worms","Grazed_Lawn"))),
                aes(x=1,y=1,color=Category,group=Category)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values=cat_cols, labels=cat_lbls) + labs(color=NULL) +
  theme_classic() + theme(legend.text=element_text(size=11))

combined <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  make_ep(e1$avg,"CME-1",e1$wp,e1$lp) + labs(tag="A"),
  make_ep(e2$avg,"CME-2",e2$wp,e2$lp) + labs(tag="B"),
  cowplot::get_legend(leg_p),
  ncol=3, rel_widths=c(1,1,0.28), align="h", axis="tb")

print(combined)
ggsave("Fig_Entero_LMM_CME1_CME2.pdf", combined, height=4, width=9)
```

## Supplementary Tables (reads per sample, merged ASV counts + taxonomy, phylogenetic trees)

These are published as static files in `../supplementary_tables/` rather
than regenerated by this script (they're built once, from the DADA2
pipeline logs and raw metadata, which aren't part of this repo):

- **`Supplementary_Tables_1-2.xlsx`**, sheet "Table1_Reads_Per_Sample" —
  DADA2 read-tracking (input → filtered → denoised → merged → non-chimeric)
  for every sample retained in the final analysis, joined to sample
  metadata.
- **`Supplementary_Tables_1-2.xlsx`**, sheet "Table2_ASV_Taxonomy_Counts" —
  a single merged ASV count + taxonomy table spanning all three datasets,
  with CME/Day/SampleType/Replicate as header rows above each sample's
  column.
- **`Supplementary_Tree_Figure1.nwk`, `..._Figure2_CME1.nwk`,
  `..._Figure2_CME2.nwk`** — one phylogenetic tree per dataset (Newick
  format); each is also already attached to its phyloseq object above.
